settlements.primary_export: Machined boiler fittings, 7.62x54mm reloaded ammunition, and heavy diesel fuel oil
settlements.defense_fortifications: Armor-plated DR-1 diesel railcars positioned as perimeter bastions, razor wire entanglement, twin DShK heavy machine gun nests in the water tower.
settlements.harlan_scout_survey: Major Volkov runs the yard with clockwork Prussian discipline. If you approach without a white flag on your rifle antenna, their spotters will put a round through your radiator at 400 meters.

settlements.primary_export: Salted river fish, cured otter pelts, distilled turnip ethanol, and forged transit passes
settlements.defense_fortifications: Reinforced concrete sluice gate control bunker, submerged spike chains across the channel, swivel-mounted 12-gauge scatterguns on barge superstructures.
settlements.harlan_scout_survey: Smuggler Baroness Rada sits on top of the hydraulic winch. She charges 10 rifle rounds or two liters of clean lamp oil per barge transit. Don't play poker with her deckhands.

settlements.geographic_coordinates: Sector 6-South, 22km South across Black Loess Flats
settlements.primary_export: Hard winter rye grain, fermented silage molasses, dried turnip flour, and woven willow baskets
settlements.defense_fortifications: Three 40-meter cylindrical concrete grain silos linked by underground trenches, earthen berms, and trained Caucasian shepherd guard dog patrols.
settlements.harlan_scout_survey: The breadbasket of the lower valley. They plow the irradiated black soil with draft horses wearing leather gas hoods. Honest folk, but they will shoot horse thieves on sight.

settlements.primary_export: Herbal wound salves, tallow funeral tapers, handwritten burial registries, and holy spring water
settlements.defense_fortifications: Thick stone monastery walls, collapsed bell tower lookout, concealed punji pit traps in the pine grove.
settlements.harlan_scout_survey: Sister Mara's home order. The subterranean artesian spring beneath the altar crypt is the sweetest, cleanest water in forty kilometers. Even raiders lower their weapons inside the nave.

settlements.primary_export: Anthracite lump coal, cast iron stove grates, crude battery sulfuric acid, and coke fuel
settlements.defense_fortifications: Earthen coal slag ramparts 6 meters high, acetylene flame projectors, pneumatic rock-drill spears.
settlements.harlan_scout_survey: Looks like the mouth of hell. Black soot on every face, roaring coke fires day and night. Master Oleg's cousins forge heavy iron crowbars and furnace grates here.

settlements.primary_export: Thermal brine sulfur salts, medicinal mud packs, refined cinnabar mercury, and hot mineral bath tokens
settlements.defense_fortifications: Flooded marble colonnades, scalding steam vent traps, barricaded granite hydrotherapy halls.
settlements.harlan_scout_survey: A surreal paradise of warm 40°C mineral pools surrounded by freezing ash dunes. The hermits who live here soak away their radiation burns in sulfur water.

settlements.geographic_coordinates: Sector 7-NW, 28km NW on Frozen Peat Bog
settlements.primary_export: Duralumin aircraft sheets, titanium hydraulic struts, insulated copper avionics wiring, and pre-war rubber tires
settlements.defense_fortifications: Fuselage bulkheads converted into multi-tier watch cabins, 23mm tail turret adapted to hand crank operation.
settlements.harlan_scout_survey: A colossal four-turboprop freighter that crash-landed on Day 1. The tail section rises 15 meters above the snow like a silver cathedral. They trade precious titanium for dry grain.

settlements.primary_export: 220V hydroelectric battery charging, copper busbars, high-tension porcelain insulators, and precision dynamo rewindings
settlements.defense_fortifications: Monolithic 80-meter concrete gravity dam crest, spillway sluice gates, searchlight towers with high-voltage perimeter fences.
settlements.harlan_scout_survey: One massive Francis turbine is still humming behind the dam's 10-meter thick powerhouse walls. The engineers guard the switchyard with electric traps and carbines.

settlements.primary_export: Tire-tread winter snowshoes, tanned wolf leathers, salvaged spark plugs, and mobile blacksmithing
settlements.defense_fortifications: Circle of six tracked logging tractors with armored cab plates, spiked snowplow blades, and mobile sniper cradles.
settlements.harlan_scout_survey: They never sleep in the same ravine twice. Driven by two massive diesel tractors burning crude wood gas. They know every hidden pass through the radioactive minefields.

settlements.primary_export: Free-market barter hub, weighing scales, silver scrap coinage, dry salt, and regional news bulletins
settlements.defense_fortifications: Demilitarized 500-meter perimeter enforced by neutral mercenary snipers; all weapons tied with wire seals at the gate.
settlements.harlan_scout_survey: The Geneva of the wasteland. Garrison officers, canal smugglers, and commune elders stand side-by-side trading salt for rifle primers. Any man who draws steel is hung from the gantry.

settlements.geographic_coordinates: Sector 5-SW, 19km SW in Open-Pit Granite Quarry
settlements.primary_export: Dressed granite building blocks, crushed ballast gravel, raw refractory quartzite sand, and hard labor
settlements.defense_fortifications: 40-meter vertical sheer rock faces with single winch elevator hoist, floodlight platforms, and guard towers armed with hunting rifles.
settlements.harlan_scout_survey: A brutal quarry prison turned slave fortress. Run by self-proclaimed 'Baron Kroll'. They lower prisoners in steel cages to drill stone 14 hours a day.

settlements.primary_export: Barometric pressure weather forecasts, optical telescope observation reports, and radioteletype synoptic charts
settlements.defense_fortifications: Sheer icy cliff approach accessible only via a hand-cranked cable car basket; reinforced copper dome.
settlements.harlan_scout_survey: Three elderly meteorologists and two radio technicians who have not come down from the peak since 1981. Their optical telescope can spot an elk herd twenty kilometers away.

settlements.primary_export: Pre-war copper plumbing pipes, porcelain bathroom tiles, subway track iron, and dried cave mushrooms
settlements.defense_fortifications: Steel blast gates wedged half-open with sandbag parapets, tripwire tin-can alarm lines, and subterranean flooded culvert barriers.
settlements.harlan_scout_survey: Two kilometers of white tiled subway platforms crowded with canvas tents and wood stoves. The smell of frying mushrooms and wet wool never leaves your nose.

settlements.primary_export: Certified non-irradiated seed stock, medicinal aloe vera, citrus rootstocks, and greenhouse honey
settlements.defense_fortifications: Geodesic double-walled lead crystal glass domes, thermal curtain shutters, armed botanist militia with hunting shotguns.
settlements.harlan_scout_survey: A breathtaking emerald oasis in the ash desert. Inside the glass dome, dwarf lemon trees and bee hives thrive under 60-year-old leaded glass. Elena's former university colleagues.

settlements.primary_export: Waterproof roofing tar, asphalt sealer, lamp pitch, creosote timber preservative, and heavy fuel distillate
settlements.defense_fortifications: Motes of sticky liquid asphalt, boiling pitch spray nozzles, and corrugated iron palisades.
settlements.harlan_scout_survey: Black smoke billows constantly from three vertical bitumen retorts. The ground is soft as warm wax. They trade waterproofing tar for salt pork and clean flour.

settlements.primary_export: High-radiation scrap steel, heavy crane cables, bulldozer blades, and crawler track pins
settlements.defense_fortifications: Lethal 1.8 R/h gamma radiation fields, collapsing crane booms, and packs of two-headed steppe wolves.
settlements.harlan_scout_survey: Fifty colossal tower cranes standing like rusted skeleton giants in the fog. Extreme gamma hotspot. Only enter in full lead-lined hazmat suits with ten-minute dosimeter timers.

settlements.primary_export: Regional courier mail routing, wire tap recordings, battery recharging, and secure telegraph messages
settlements.defense_fortifications: Log blockhouse with concrete firing slit foundation, razor wire perimeter, and tripwire flares.
settlements.harlan_scout_survey: A lonely outpost sitting on the main copper telegraph trunk line. Four telegraphers take shifts 24 hours a day clicking Morse keys. They trade hot soup for gossip and dry batteries.

settlements.primary_export: Nutritional brewer's yeast cakes, dark bock beer, malt extract, and copper boiling kettles
settlements.defense_fortifications: Vaulted brick beer cellars 10 meters underground, oak barrel barricades, and pressure-fed boiling water hoses.
settlements.harlan_scout_survey: Deep subterranean brick vaults that survived the airburst. The air smells wonderfully of roasting barley and fermenting malt. Their nutritional yeast cakes keep half the valley healthy.

settlements.primary_export: Bridge crossing authorization, river depth sounding reports, and contraband contraband inspection
settlements.defense_fortifications: Concrete bridgehead pillboxes with 14.5mm KPV heavy machine guns, demolition charges wired to center span piers.
settlements.harlan_scout_survey: The only surviving road bridge across the swollen river. Co-garrisoned by three neutral factions under the 1986 Demarcation Protocol. If fighting breaks out, they blow the charges.

settlements.settlement_name: The Free Settlement of Tessarat (Bunker 44 Surface Town)
settlements.primary_export: Sonya's Golden Winter Apples, clean artesian water, precision machine parts, and the Democratic Charter of Day 3650
settlements.defense_fortifications: Terraced granite retaining walls, solar skylight atriums, automated pneumatic blast gates, and the Citizen Militia Brigade.
settlements.harlan_scout_survey: Our home. What started as twenty-four exhausted survivors huddled in a dark military shelter has grown into a terraced garden town under the open sky. Sonya's apple tree is in full bloom. The capital of the new world.
